title: Rosalind and the Well
author: A. M. Amberdale
blurb: August Underhill, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
